text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle, Kitasan Black 
crossed the finish line in 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond acknowledged Kitasan 
Black's running and praised her 
consecutive victories. Just then, a voice 
interrupted their conversation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio. 
Inspired by Satono Diamond and the others' 
race, they had come to declare a 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen announced her entry into 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn), while Tokai Teio 
announced hers for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond wished to run in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn). Taking her wish into 
account, her Trainer suggested the Kyoto 
Daishoten as a prep race.
